title: Canonical maps and evaluation normalization for the stratum Hom comparison
statement: For ordinary constant-coefficient module derived categories on the small etale and pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules, def-pur-derived-internal-hom], and a closed/open factorization s=c followed by v [def-weil-closed-immersion, def-weil-open-immersion], retain the existing derived tensor, internal Hom and right-ordered evaluation. Identify derived extension with exact closed/open extension by rightDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory, and transport the projection map [lem-sf-immersion-projection-site-comparison] by this isomorphism. Transport the ordinary derived pull/push adjunction to the factorized exact pullback. For supplied exceptional adjoints [lem-weil-finite-duality-locally-closed-comparison], HomIso is the two-variable natural isomorphism from ambient internal Hom out of extension to ordinary pushforward of stratum internal Hom. Normalized means exactly that the tensor transpose of its inverse is projection, extension of the ordinary counit tensor the identity, extension of evaluation, and the exceptional counit. The ordinary direct-image mate is the specified D+ mate [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image-canonical-mate] included by the canonical compatibility isomorphisms. Delta is the canonical transported extension comparison, homChange is Hom of its inverse, and stratumMap is evaluation comparison [def-sf-evaluation-hom-site-comparison] followed by Hom of gamma. IdentityAndIsomorphisms and Conclusion are the original displayed equation, conditional invertibility clauses and quantifiers in the finite-duality comparison, with no mathematical change.

    (TS : D ⥤ D ⥤ D) (HS : Dᵒᵖ ⥤ D ⥤ D)

    (a : L ⊣ R) (b : F ⊣ G)
    (evX : ∀ P M : C, (TX.obj ((HX.obj (op P)).obj M)).obj P ⟶ M)
    (evS : ∀ P M : D, (TS.obj ((HS.obj (op P)).obj M)).obj P ⟶ M)
    (proj : ∀ (T : C) (P : D), (TX.obj T).obj (F.obj P) ⟶
      F.obj ((TS.obj (L.obj T)).obj P))
